title: ‘It Would Be Great to Win All Three’: Chloé Dygert Dreams of Gold Medal Sweep at the LA 2028 Olympics
content:
Chloé Dygert confirms to Velo she will target gold in road and track at the LA 2028 Olympics after her return to US pro racing.
